A type of weapon used and referenced as [[Aviendha]] is going through the [[glass columns]] in [[Rhuidean]]. They are described as the "long rod-like weapons" by [[Malidra]]: "There was a hiss of sound—one of the Lightmaker weapons—and something popped against her back. It felt like she’d been hit with a small rock."{{ref/book|13|48}} The name comes from [[Norlesh]]'s PoV. 

"Stave" is a synonym for "rod". Their length and ability to fire projectiles would make them similar to a rifle. They do not, however, produce a bang, but rather a hissing sound, so it's possible that they do not use gunpowder. They may be a [[ter'angreal]], but this is speculation.

The item is not referenced in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].
